_comment: Site-wide pop-up. active:true shows it. id: change whenever posting a NEW message so prior dismissers see it. mode: 'once' = one time per visitor; 'acknowledge' = until they click Don't show again; 'untilDate' = hides itself after endDate (YYYY-MM-DD). linkUrl/linkLabel optional.
title: Welcome to the Skyland Conference
body: The all-new Skyland Conference site is here. Browse every school's schedule, follow conference standings, explore our championships history, and stay connected all season long.
